notes: First DeepSeek self-report inaccuracy in the series: claimed 12 tests in character-detail.test.ts, actual 9 (its own 78 total was only consistent with 9+6 — fabricated per-describe padding). Orchestrator acceptance fix: removed the null fields, made assertions unconditional; all 45 client tests still green, proving the client code was correct and only the test evidence was vacuous.
